Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and G5358; hostile to virtue:--despiser of those that are good.
BiblicalUsage: Despisers of those that are good — one mark of the perilous last days, named beside the loveless and the unthankful. The word is hatred aimed at goodness itself.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this is the ugliest mark on Paul's list: hating what is good is the last step away from God.
